	// Toggle icon inside a toggler
	function toggleTogglerIcon(toggler) {
		togglerIcons = toggler.querySelectorAll('.diks-icon');

	// Function for closing all dropdown navigations
	function closeAllDropdownNavigations() {
		closeMainDropdownNavigation();
		closeUserDropdownNavigation();
	}

	// Close main nav or user nav if hidden screen reader only close navigation button is clicked
	let closeDropdownMainNav = document.getElementById('diks-close-dropdown-main-nav');

		closeDropdownUserNav.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
			e.stopPropagation();
			closeUserDropdownNavigation();
		});

	// Trap focus inside opened dropdown navigation
	document.addEventListener('keydown', function(event) {
		// Initialize variables
		var ssoLinks = document.getElementById('diks-sso-links');
		var linksUserNav = "";
		var firstElUserNav = "";
		var lastElUserNav = "";
		var mainDropdownLastNavLinks = document.getElementById('dropdown-customer-nav'); // Last navigation element inside of main dropdown navigation
		var linksMainDropdownNav = "";
		var firstElMainDropdownNav = ""
		var lastElMainDropdownNav = "";

		// Set user nav variable values if SSO links exist
		if (ssoLinks) {
			linksUserNav = ssoLinks.querySelectorAll('.diks-navigation__link');
			firstElUserNav = document.getElementById('diks-close-dropdown-user-nav');
			lastElUserNav = linksUserNav[linksUserNav.length - 1];
		}

		// Set main dropdown nav variable values if main dropdown last nav links exist
		if (mainDropdownLastNavLinks) {
			linksMainDropdownNav = mainDropdownLastNavLinks.querySelectorAll('.diks-navigation__link');
			firstElMainDropdownNav = document.getElementById('diks-close-dropdown-main-nav');
			lastElMainDropdownNav = linksMainDropdownNav[linksMainDropdownNav.length - 1];
		}

		// If darkmode-toggler is found set it as the last element of main dropdown nav
		if ( document.getElementById('diks-darkmode-toggler') ) {
			lastElMainDropdownNav = document.getElementById('diks-darkmode-toggler');
		}

		// Close all dropdown navigations & reposition fixed header when ESC key is pressed
		if (event.key === "Escape" || event.key === "Esc") {
			closeAllDropdownNavigations();
		}
		// Trap focus inside user navigation and/or main dropdown navigation when they are open
		if (event.keyCode === 9) {
			if (event.shiftKey && (document.activeElement === firstElUserNav || document.activeElement === firstElMainDropdownNav)) {
				event.preventDefault();
				if (document.activeElement === firstElUserNav) {
					lastElUserNav.focus();
				}
				else if ( document.activeElement === firstElMainDropdownNav ) {
					lastElMainDropdownNav.focus();
				}
			}
			else if (!event.shiftKey && (document.activeElement === lastElUserNav || document.activeElement === lastElMainDropdownNav)) {
				event.preventDefault();
				if (document.activeElement === lastElUserNav) {
					firstElUserNav.focus();
				}
				else if ( document.activeElement === lastElMainDropdownNav ) {
					firstElMainDropdownNav.focus();
				}
			}
		}
	});

					userDropdownNavigationToggler.classList.remove('diks-dropdown-toggler--is-open');

				// Set aria-expanded

					}

						closeUserDropdownNavigation();
					}
				});

			}

		});

	function closeMainDropdownNavigation() {
		// Main dropdown navigation
		if (mainDropdownNavigation) {
			if (mainDropdownNavigation.classList.contains('diks-dropdown-navigation--is-open')) {
				// Close main dropdown nav by removing --is-open class
				mainDropdownNavigation.classList.remove('diks-dropdown-navigation--is-open');
				// Remove --is-open class from main dropdown navigation toggler
				mainDropdownNavigationToggler.classList.remove('diks-dropdown-toggle--is-open');

				document.body.classList.remove('diks-body--dropdown-navigation-is-open');

				// Turn off shade effect
				mainDropdownNavigationShade.classList.remove('diks-dropdown-navigation-shade--is-visible');

	// Main Navigation Dropdown
	if (mainDropdownNavigation) {
		let mainDropdownNavigationAriaControls = mainDropdownNavigationToggler.getAttribute('data-toggle'); // aria-controls value for main dropown navigation toggler

				// Set aria-expanded
				mainDropdownNavigationToggler.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');

				// Open this toggle
				mainDropdownNavigation.classList.add('diks-dropdown-navigation--is-open');
				// Add is-open class to body
				document.body.classList.add('diks-body--dropdown-navigation-is-open');
				// Turn on shade effect
				mainDropdownNavigationShade.classList.add('diks-dropdown-navigation-shade--is-visible');

				// Close main Dropdown Navigation when visible shade area is clicked
				document.querySelector('.diks-dropdown-navigation-shade--is-visible').addEventListener('click', function() {
					closeMainDropdownNavigation();
				});

				// Close user dropdown navigation if it's open
				closeUserDropdownNavigation();

			}

	}

	const useDragThreshold = false;

	// Horizontally scrollable & draggable navigation
	class HorizontalScrollDragger {
		constructor(element) {
			this.slider = typeof element === 'string' ? document.querySelector(element) : element instanceof Element ? element : null;
			if (this.slider === null) return console.error('HorizontalScrollDragger: Element not found');

			this.isDown = false;
			this.preventClick = false;
			this.startX;
			this.scrollLeft;

			this.dragThreshold = 5;
			this.dragSensitivity = 3;
			this.dragged = false;

			this.init();
		}

		init() {
			this.slider.addEventListener('mousedown', (e) => this.handleMouseDown(e));
			this.slider.addEventListener('mouseleave', () => this.handleMouseLeave());
			this.slider.addEventListener('mouseup', () => this.handleMouseUp());
			this.slider.addEventListener('mousemove', (e) => this.handleMouseMove(e));
			this.slider.addEventListener('click', (e) => this.handleClick(e));
		}

		handleMouseDown(e) {
			this.isDown = true;
			this.slider.classList.add('diks-navigation--draggable-active');
			this.startX = e.pageX - this.slider.offsetLeft;
			this.scrollLeft = this.slider.scrollLeft;
			this.preventClick = false;
		}

		handleMouseLeave() {
			this.isDown = false;
			this.slider.classList.remove('diks-navigation--draggable-active');
		}

		handleMouseUp() {
			this.isDown = false;
			this.slider.classList.remove('diks-navigation--draggable-active');
		}

		handleMouseMove(e) {
			if (!this.isDown) return;

			if ( useDragThreshold == true ) {
				const xWithThreshold = e.pageX - this.slider.offsetLeft;
				const delta = xWithThreshold - this.startX;

				// If not yet dragging, check threshold
				if (!this.dragged && Math.abs(delta) > this.dragThreshold) {
					this.dragged = true;
					this.preventClick = true;

					// Reset baseline so scrolling starts smoothly from here
					this.startX = xWithThreshold;
					this.scrollLeft = this.slider.scrollLeft;
				}

				if (this.dragged) {
					e.preventDefault();
					const walkWithThreshold = (xWithThreshold - this.startX) * this.dragSensitivity; // adjust sensitivity
					this.slider.scrollLeft = this.scrollLeft - walkWithThreshold;
				}
			}
			else {
				e.preventDefault();
				const x = e.pageX - this.slider.offsetLeft;
				const walk = (x - this.startX) * this.dragSensitivity; // adjust sensitivity
				this.slider.scrollLeft = this.scrollLeft - walk;
				this.preventClick = true;
			}

		}

		handleClick(e) {
			if ( useDragThreshold == true && this.preventClick && this.dragged ) {
				e.preventDefault();
			}
			else if ( useDragThreshold == false && this.preventClick) {
				e.preventDefault();
			}
		}
	}

	let scrollableNavs = document.querySelectorAll('.diks-navigation--draggable');

	function handleScrollableNavScrollbars(scrollableNavElement) {
		// If scrollable area is wider (scrollWidth) than what's visible (clientWidth) the element has scrollbars
